title: A linear functional on test forms bounded by B·sup|ω| is a current of mass ≤ B (supplied step 4)
statement: Let P, q ∈ ℕ, U ⊆ ℝ^P, T₀ : TestFormOn U q →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ a linear functional and B ≥ 0 such that |T₀(ω)| ≤ B·C for every ω ∈ TestFormOn U q and every C ∈ ℝ with covectorEuclideanNorm(ω(x)) ≤ C for all x ∈ ℝ^P. Then there is T ∈ GeometricCurrentOn U q with T(ω) = T₀(ω) for every ω and T.mass ≤ ENNReal.ofReal B.
lean_statement: ∀ (P q : ℕ) (U : Set (Eucl P)) (T₀ : TestFormOn U q →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ) (B : ℝ), 0 ≤ B → (∀ (ω : TestFormOn U q) (C : ℝ), (∀ x, covectorEuclideanNorm ((ω : DifferentialForm (Eucl P) q) x) ≤ C) → |T₀ ω| ≤ B * C) → ∃ T : GeometricCurrentOn U q, (∀ ω, T ω = T₀ ω) ∧ T.mass ≤ ENNReal.ofReal B
